thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert (P1) - elevated 5xx rate for customer 'NordicPay' on Dedicated cluster eu-west-2-dk-cluster. Error spike starting ~T-6m. Pager: @alice (oncall)

alice (oncall): paging in. seeing 5xx + gateway timeouts from nordicpay tenant. checking dashboards now.

carla (support): customer reported transaction failures earlier, high duration + HTTP 502/504. they're seeing retries from their side. ticket #ND-342 opened.

alice (oncall): logs show surge in GPU utilization on nodepool dp-eu-w2-gpu-07 and heavy KV cache pressure. suspect noisy neighbor causing OOM throttles.

bob (eng-runtime): joining. any recent deployments for nordicpay?

carla (support): nordicpay confirmed no deploys on their side in last hour.

maria (sre): copying perf traces from tracing UI: https://console.redwood.internal/trace/abc123 (link for team)

alice (oncall): running quick tenant query: `rwictl tenant-metrics --tenant nordicpay --start -00:10m --end now` output snippet:
```
requests_total: 12000
5xx_rate: 18.6%
avg_latency_ms: 820
gpu_util_pct(node07): 98
kv_cache_miss_rate: 42%
```

bob (eng-runtime): 18% 5xx is bad. node07 saturated. can we cordon node07 and rebalance? that will evict some pods. risk: recovery might push load to other nodes and cause cascading.

alice (oncall): starting mitigation plan: 1) enable tenant-level throttling to reduce concurrency 2) rebalance tenant to other nodepools 3) if necessary enable fallback model variant (smaller) 4) ask CS to notify customer that we're mitigating.

carla (support): telling customer: "We're investigating intermittent failures and are applying mitigations to reduce error rate. I'll update every 15 minutes."

alice (oncall): executing throttle: `rwictl tenant-config set nordicpay --concurrency 8 --burst 16` --> applied.

incident-bot: action logged: tenant-config update by alice at 1934567985.

alice (oncall): enabling slow-start circuit for nordicpay routing: `rwictl routing update --tenant nordicpay --gradual 60s`

bob (eng-runtime): kicking off rebalance: `rwictl rebalance --tenant nordicpay --from-node dp-eu-w2-gpu-07 --to-nodepool dp-eu-w2-gpu-burst` (will start moving sessions, may drop KV cache). ETA ~ 45s for first pods.

maria (sre): coordinate with autoscaler: if we failover, autoscaler may spin up extra capacity. temporarily disable scale-to-zero for that nodepool: `rwictl autoscale set dp-eu-w2-gpu-burst --min 2`

alice (oncall): note: if we hit global capacity limits, fallback to hosted routing needed.

dave (cs): customer wants SLA clarity. sending heads-up: "we're throttling to stabilize, you may see reduced throughput for a short period; working to restore full capacity."

incident-bot: rebalance job 7f9c started, trackers: https://console.redwood.internal/jobs/7f9c

alice (oncall): initial metrics after throttle + rebalance (T+2m): `5xx_rate -> 11.2%`, `avg_latency -> 540ms`. improvement but still high.

bob (eng-runtime): seeing KV cache warmup. miss rate trending down. however node08 now at 92% GPU. consider enabling tenant-specific eviction policy on heavy shards.

alice (oncall): enabling eviction policy: `rwictl tenant-tuning set nordicpay --kv-priority low --max_shard_p99 200mb` applied.

carla (support): customer: "noticed fewer failures, thanks. still some timeouts around peak times."

maria (sre): running mitigation 2: increment reserved burst for nordicpay for next 30m: `rwictl dedicated-reserve add --tenant nordicpay --gpus 2 --duration 30m` -> provision started (may take 90s).

incident-bot: dedicated-reserve request queued, id rr-21.

alice (oncall): after reserve allocation (T+6m) we see 5xx_rate -> 3.4%, latency -> 210ms. KV miss -> 12%. Good signal.

bob (eng-runtime): suggestion: postmortem actions: add tenant-level ingress shaping rule to prevent future noisy neighbor spikes, add alert for sustained per-node GPU >90% for >2m, and enhance autoscaler to consider per-tenant burst allowances.

dave (cs): customer asked about root cause timeline & next steps. I'll propose a follow-up meeting.

carla (support): creating incident ticket with timeline, cc: nordicpay SOC, include commanded mitigation logs.

alice (oncall): handing off to maria for post-incident checks and follow-up. maria, take it from here for next 4 hours.

maria (sre): ack. I'll keep monitoring and run deeper heap/eviction analysis next hour. assigning action items to eng-runtime for long-term fixes.

bob (eng-runtime): will take backlog item: `ENG-6785` implement tenant-aware packing and hard caps.

alice (oncall): closing pager for now. If 5xx >5% for next 10m reopen. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident P1 nordicpay-dedicated-elevated-5xx marked resolved by alice at 1934568270. Postmortem scheduled: 1934571600 (in 1 hour).
